Disposa d'una barra de 7 metres amb 4 tamborets, equipada amb una petita sortida de fums, cafetera, tirador de cervesa, màquina registradora, ampolleria i rentavaixelles. Cuina amb sortida de fums condicionada amb 1 nevera, 4 congeladors, 1 forn, 1 planxa, 1 fregidora de 2 cossos i 4 fogons. inv.desc_en:
Transfer: €330,000.

Bar restaurant C3 mixed, renovated, of 100m² distributed on 1 floor, with a capacity of 38 diners, with a 2-meter glass facade. It has a 7-meter bar with 4 stools, equipped with a small smoke vent, coffee maker, beer tap, cash register, bottle rack and dishwasher. Kitchen with smoke vent equipped with 1 refrigerator, 4 freezers, 1 oven, 1 griddle, 1 double fryer and 4 burners. The premises have TV, air conditioning, 3 toilets, one of them adapted for people with reduced mobility and storage, and is also soundproofed and fireproofed. It is located in a commercial thoroughfare, tourism and nightlife area.

TERRACE WITH 6 TABLES, 24 CHAIRS AND 2 PARASOLS.

Contract: 10 years
Incasol Deposit: 2 months
Additional Guarantee: 1 year bank guarantee.
